description:
Join us this Thursday on VSRF LIVE as we welcome back Drs. Kat Lindley and Lynn Fynn for an in-depth conversation about the bird flu panic that has been making waves across the nation. With news of the virus spreading rapidly among bird and cattle populations, misinformation and confusion have reached an all-time high. Drs. Lindley and Fynn will help separate fact from fiction and provide a clear, science-backed understanding of what’s truly happening. Additionally, we will be brining on Beef Initiative founder Texas Slim to discuss the outbreak’s likely impacts on our food supply and what this could mean for national food security.Show more The current bird flu epidemic has infected more than 500 species of animals, including 485 avian and at least 70 mammal. The outbreak is being described as the fastest spreading and largest ever, posing a significant threat to biodiversity worldwide.
So whether you’re concerned about the potential for an actual human outbreak or just curious about the media’s warped spinning of the current situation, Drs. Lindley and Fynn will provide clarity and expert analysis. Get your questions ready, and tune in for an informative and eye-opening session!
Don’t miss it: Thursday at 7 PM EST | 4PM PST. And as always, please share this link and bring some friends!
